title: A long payer name reads in full on the Customer card
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser at least 1440 pixels wide.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with a name of at least 30 characters.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Pick customer B in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The list opens.

Step 4:

  • The "Bill To" field reads customer B's whole name; no part of it is cut off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R2: “The field reads "This customer" when the customer pays for itself, otherwise the Bill To's name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
